preconditions.description: The length of the array n must be between 3 and 5000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the guessed array in the format '! a1 a2 ... an'.
The length of the guessed array must be equal to n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**5 for ai in a)
postconditions.description: All elements of the guessed array must be positive integers not exceeding 100,000.
